name: cavalry
description: Visual Stack by Cavalry Collective — a visual software planning and execution workflow for Claude Code, invoked as /cavalry:<skill>. Currently: user-story-map (plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map), wireframe (build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it), phase-wireframe (see a signed-off mockup at each release phase), and init (start a project from the Cavalry template with a stack + add-on chooser). The interactive ones link the open page back to the Claude session, so edits and feedback return without copy-paste.
